scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:built
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run build && bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:rust && tsc --noEmit && bun run test:built
scripts.dev: bun run build && alchemy dev alchemy.run.ts --stage dev --profile minutei
scripts.plan: bun run build && alchemy plan alchemy.run.ts --profile minutei
scripts.deploy: bun run build && alchemy deploy alchemy.run.ts --profile minutei
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --locked -- -D warnings
